headline: Blue wave, green futures: Democrats take Congress, AMD pops ~6% premarket, our 3-month calls lead the S&P on 3 of 4; no Bold Bet, Max leans the Cavaliers at 43.5¢ (+1.4 pts); Capitals lean lost 6-5
top_call: Democrats swept Congress overnight, Nasdaq futures dropped as much as 2.4%, then clawed it all back. Our 3-month calls barely blinked: T-Mobile is +6.1 points ahead of the S&P 500 since Oct 25, NextEra +3.5, General Dynamics +0.7, Microsoft -0.7 as of Tuesday's close. Three of four ahead, one within a rounding error.
backdrop: U.S. stock futures rose Wednesday after Democrats won control of both the House and Senate, reversing an overnight drop of as much as 2.4% in Nasdaq-100 futures and 1.4% in S&P 500 futures. AMD is up about 6% premarket after its Q3 beat, while Tesla and SpaceX slid over 4% and Arm, Qualcomm, Uber and McDonald's report today.

ai.headline: AI stocks split after the midterms: Tesla and SpaceX fall over 4% premarket as Democrats win in data-center hubs, while Nvidia, Alphabet, Meta and Microsoft trade up 1-2% and Amazon 2.7%
ai.why: Wall Street just priced in data-center moratorium risk, and decided the hyperscalers can afford the zoning lawyers.

ai.headline: Anthropic's amended IPO filing says its future models may 'imminently' meet its own threshold for 'dramatically accelerated progress attributable to AI'; no current model has crossed it
ai.why: An AI lab putting 'our AI may speed itself up' in the risk factors. That's a sentence lawyers don't write for fun.

ai.headline: OpenAI launches a 'Grid Protectors Program', promising its future campuses will cut power use when the grid is strained, starting with up to 1,000 MW of demand response in Effingham County, Georgia
ai.why: Data-center backlash just won elections. Offering to dim the lights during a heat wave is OpenAI reading the room.

ai.headline: Google switches Gemini off by default for students on its school software, but schools that opt out of AI also lose Google Search by default
ai.why: Google admitting Search and AI are now one product. Opting out of the robot means opting out of the library.

ai.headline: AMD beats Q3 estimates as data center sales nearly double and guides Q4 to about $17 billion, above Wall Street's view; shares up about 6% premarket
ai.why: In a Nasdaq correction, AMD just handed the AI bulls a receipt. See our plain-English explainer.

no_bets_note: Nothing cleared our bar at 7:05 AM ET across 14 NBA games, 4 NHL games and 2 MACtion college football games with DraftKings lines. The biggest edge on the board was the Blackhawks at 29.5¢ in Florida (+2.0 pts), still short of 2.5 and way under our 40¢ floor. Closest in-band misses: Cavaliers 43.5¢ at OKC (+1.4, line moved toward them since the open), 76ers 45.5¢ at Detroit (+1.3, line moved away), Sharks 40.5¢ at LA (+1.2, line moved toward them), Nets 39.5¢ vs Charlotte (+1.2, no open line to check). DraftKings lines via ESPN.

lean.label: Cavaliers
lean.market: NBA: CLE @ OKC, Wed Nov 4 8:00 PM ET
lean.why: A lean, not a bet. DraftKings has Cleveland at +114 in Oklahoma City, a 44.9% shot without the vig, and Polymarket sells it for 43.5¢: +1.4 points, about half our 2.5 bar. The line has inched toward the Cavs since the open (+116 to +114), which is the only reason Max is talking. Road dog in OKC is a brave place to stand; consider this a polite nod, not a fist pump.
